rows.grounds: yajet = 'one-should-worship'; optative (vidhi-liṅ) expressing injunction to worship
aṣṭa+dale = 'in-eight-petaled-lotus'; bahuvrīhi/karmadhāraya compound qualifying padme, locative singular neuter
padme = 'padme' (in the lotus); locative singular neuter, locus of worship
deva+agra+ādi+pradakṣiṇam = 'clockwise-from-deva-and-others'; compound indicating circumambulation starting with deva and others, accusative used adverbially
